description: A deterministic, manually labeled set of short excerpts from 50 real official subscription, billing, pricing, and help pages. Labels describe evidence visible in each excerpt, not a legal conclusion about the full service.

records.text: Paid Subscriptions continue indefinitely until cancelled. You will be billed on a recurring basis. We do not provide refunds or credits for partial subscription periods.
